sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:13

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:13:1
items.html: And the light of the forehead, etc., and its existence begins from the Tabur to the end of his legs: This is because all the ten Sefirot of the new MA are an offspring of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, since they emerged upon the aspect of the screen of the Guf of Nekudim, which was refined and rose to the forehead, as above in the Inner Light (page 599, the passage beginning “It decreed,” see there). Therefore it cannot clothe the first Rosh of Nekudim, which stands from the Tabur of AK upward; rather, it begins from the Peh of the first Rosh, which is found in the place of the Tabur of AK. And necessarily its existence begins from the Tabur, as far as the end of his legs.
